summary.name: VEED Video Background Remover
summary.one_liner: A browser-based AI tool from VEED that removes or replaces the background of a video or GIF in one click, with a green screen removal option.
use_cases: Removing a messy room behind a talking head video
Replacing backgrounds in social clips, video ads, or tutorials
Removing a green screen from a filmed clip
Making a GIF transparent for stickers or reactions
Creating multiple background variations for marketing campaigns
Reformatting vertical video to horizontal without black bars
summary.what_it_does: Removes the background from a video or GIF with one click using AI, making the clip transparent so it can be layered over an image, video, color, or stock footage. A separate Green Screen toggle removes green backgrounds from footage, including clips recorded with the in-browser webcam recorder. Replacement backgrounds can be uploaded, taken from a stock library, or generated with AI image and video models. The page also mentions color correction, background noise removal, AI Background Expand for changing aspect ratio, auto subtitles, and downloading the result.
notable: One-click AI background removal for video and GIF
Green screen toggle plus in-browser webcam recorder
AI Background Expand to change video aspect ratio without black bars
caveats: Free to try only once; continued use requires upgrading to a Pro plan
Green Screen option works best on footage filmed with even lighting against a green screen
Part of a larger online editor, so the tool is used within the VEED platform
